addons.comparison: Top ten are ranked within each Glean week, not the ATN ranking.
addons.description: Latest add-ons ping per client; excludes themes and built-in add-ons.
addons.label: Active extensions

locales.description: Application locale from each client's latest weekly baseline ping.
locales.label: Application languages

addrbook_addressbook_count.description: Address books by type, using each client's latest weekly snapshot.
addrbook_addressbook_count.label: Address books

calendar_calendar_count.description: Calendars by type, using each client's latest weekly snapshot.
calendar_calendar_count.label: Calendars

calendar_read_only_calendar_count.description: Read-only calendars by type, using each client's latest weekly snapshot.
calendar_read_only_calendar_count.label: Read-only calendars

compose_mails_sent.description: Messages sent, summed across distinct pings.
compose_mails_sent.label: All messages sent

filelink_uploaded_size.description: Bytes uploaded by provider, summed across distinct pings.
filelink_uploaded_size.label: Filelink uploads

mail_account_count.description: Accounts by type, using each reporting client's latest weekly snapshot.
mail_account_count.label: Accounts

mail_failed_email_account_setup.description: Failed setups by configuration source, summed across distinct pings.
mail_failed_email_account_setup.label: Failed account setup

mail_mails_read.description: Message-read events, summed across distinct pings.
mail_mails_read.label: All messages read

mail_mails_read_secure.aggregation: Counts secure-message read events from distinct event pings. Each event belongs to one security category. This older probe counts newly read messages; secure-message loads are a separate metric.
mail_mails_read_secure.description: Newly read OpenPGP and S/MIME messages, grouped by signing and encryption.
mail_mails_read_secure.label: Secure messages read

mail_oauth2_provider_count.description: Incoming mail accounts using OAuth, by issuer, from each client's latest weekly snapshot.
mail_oauth2_provider_count.label: OAuth accounts

mail_secure_mail_loaded.aggregation: Counts secure-message load events from distinct event pings, including reopening previously read messages. Each event belongs to one security category. These are loads, not distinct messages or sends.
mail_secure_mail_loaded.description: OpenPGP and S/MIME message loads, grouped by signing and encryption.
mail_secure_mail_loaded.label: Secure messages loaded

mail_successful_email_account_setup.description: Successful setups by configuration source, summed across distinct pings.
mail_successful_email_account_setup.label: Successful account setup

mail_websearch_usage.description: Web searches by engine, summed across distinct pings.
mail_websearch_usage.label: Web searches

oauth.description: OAuth authentication-window outcomes from distinct event pings. Counts windows shown, not background token refreshes or accounts.
oauth.label: OAuth authentication

platforms.description: Operating system version from each client's latest weekly baseline ping. Windows 10 and 11 use the reported build number; macOS reports Darwin kernel versions, and Linux reports kernel versions.
platforms.label: Platforms

privacy.coverage_versions: major version; minimum client population applies

source: Thunderbird Desktop Glean via STMO / Telemetry (BigQuery)
window: Monday–Sunday UTC; submission date; seven completed days
